facts.fact: DHIS2 (HISP) states that when Togo moved its routine immunisation (EPI) reporting off DVD-MT into the national HMIS on DHIS2, data entry and analysis were decentralised down to the facility level; it gives EPI report completeness of 99.1% in 2018 and 99.3% in 2019 and on-time submission rising from 38.2% to 83% (both printed as 2019).

DHIS2 (HISP) states that Togo implemented the DHIS2 immunization package and data quality tool with the support of Gavi; the statement covers the immunisation reporting within the national DHIS2, not the whole system, and no domestic funding is mentioned.

systems.tiers: data entry down to facility level (for EPI data)
central team only; replaced by DHIS2

note: The published date is inferred (year); the figures the page gives are for 2018 and 2019, used for as_of. Both facts concern aggregate immunisation reporting inside the national DHIS2, one programme's stream rather than the whole HMIS.
